**Complexity theory as a foundation**

> 以复杂性理论为根基

## Why it matters (为何重要)

Cornell built one of the earliest CS departments and used it to establish the theory of computation as a discipline.

> 康奈尔建立了最早的计算机系之一，并在此把计算复杂性确立为一门学科。

## Background (背景)

Founded in 1865 in Ithaca, New York, Cornell is private with a public mission; its Computer Science department was established in 1965.

> 1865 年创办于纽约州伊萨卡，是“私立而承担公共使命”的大学；计算机科学系成立于 1965 年。

## People (人物)

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Juris Hartmanis | founding CS chair (1965), co-recipient of the 1993 Turing Award for establishing computational complexity theory |
| John Hopcroft | 1986 Turing Award and co-author of the classic automata textbook |
| Eva Tardos | elected to the National Academy of Sciences in 2013 for network-flow and approximation algorithms |

> **Juris Hartmanis** — 首任计算机系主任（1965），因奠定计算复杂性理论获 1993 年图灵奖。**John Hopcroft** — 1986 年图灵奖得主，经典自动机教材合著者。**Eva Tardos** — 因网络流与近似算法于 2013 年当选美国国家科学院院士。

## Courses (课程)

| Course | Title |
|:--|:--|
| CS 1110 | Introduction to Computing |
| CS 2110 | Object-Oriented Programming and Data Structures |
| CS 2800 | Mathematical Foundations |
| CS 3410 | Computer System Organization |
| CS 4820 | Analysis of Algorithms |

> CS 1110 计算导论 · CS 2110 面向对象编程与数据结构 · CS 2800 计算数学基础 · CS 3410 计算机系统组织 · CS 4820 算法分析。

## In this book (本书收录)

- [020 · Enigma (CS 3110)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/020-cornell-enigma)

**The Enigma project is functional-programming in the Cornell mould — types and pure functions first, a tradition Hartmanis and Hopcroft helped establish.**

> Enigma 项目是康奈尔式函数式编程：类型与纯函数先行，这一传统由 Hartmanis 与 Hopcroft 等人奠定。
